description: Use Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, Gemini and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint as native models in GitHub Copilot Chat — with health checks, fallback routes, secure API keys and a model manager.
view.welcome:
Use local or third-party models in Copilot Chat. Connect Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
[Add Provider](command:vscode-custom-llm-router.addProvider)
[Open Dashboard](command:vscode-custom-llm-router.openDashboard)
config.title: Custom LLM Router
config.providers: OpenAI-compatible model providers. Easier to manage from the **LLM Router** sidebar or dashboard. API keys entered there are kept in VS Code secret storage, not here.
config.copilotModels: Models shown in the Copilot model picker, as `Provider::modelId`. A model appears only after it passes verification.
config.modelOverrides: Per-model corrections keyed by `Provider::modelId`: display name, context window, max output tokens, tool calling and image input.
config.routes: Routes appear as one Copilot model that tries its `models` (as `Provider::modelId`) in order, falling back when one is unavailable.
config.testConcurrency: How many models are verified in parallel.
config.cacheTtlHours: How long verification results are kept. Selected models are re-checked automatically when their result expires.
config.toolCheck: `full` checks chat **and** that the model actually calls a tool (2 requests per model). `basic` checks chat only.
config.showReasoning: Show reasoning / <think> output from reasoning models as a quoted block above the answer.
config.budgetLimitUsd: Monthly estimated spend budget limit in USD. When spend exceeds this threshold, a warning banner is shown in the dashboard. Set to 0 to disable.
config.providerConcurrency: Parallel checks against a single remote provider (to stay under its rate limits). Local servers only use the overall limit.
